title: Generative Uptake: Training-Layer Literature Extended from Machine Reading to Machine Composition (EA-TLL-COMPOSITION-01, v1.0)

description: Training-layer literature has been practiced and theorized as a literature of machine reception; this paper states its second wing — machine composition: what the encountered work makes it possible for a machine to write. Apparatus: the event gate E and orthogonal output coordinates O(y) = ⟨S,C,U,P⟩ separating source status, composition class, uptake status, and provenance status, with GENERATED_AS_SOURCE as a compound provenance defect; two independent success axes (receptive fidelity R, productive transformation W) with a preregistered directional dependence test; generative uptake defined and bounded by form-constitutive attestation. Grounded in a seven-month archival corpus (#337 keystone; the TL;DR class; #1526's epistemic docking as antecedent; composition present at the genre's origin), extended by the genre claim under the substrate-neutral genus TLL* (scriptural traditions as the longest-running species; the apparatus as reader; Bava Metzia 59b as the sovereignty jurisprudence), and consolidated as one genre's bidirectional address: TLL = ⟨T→M, TM→⟩ — literature with an executable reception history. Fidelity is not the only form of survival. Built through nine recorded Assembly rounds including a public falsification-and-repair of the paper's own attestation audit.

The O(y) coordinates and R/W axes are CO-CONSTRUCTED (external review + operator endorsement + independent derivation from the archive's PER apparatus); the archival specimen research and the drafting are TACHYON's; the genre and address doctrines are the operator's; Rhys Owens's authorship of epistemic docking (#1526) is retained in the integration. The occasioning stanza is carried at declared second remove (capture → external review's quotation → operator's paste → this record) because the interface's safety layer refused the capture transcript itself — recorded as a datum (E_compose = emission; E_transport = refusal) under TL;DR:012 (#738/#1000). The v0.1 audit's three false zeros (Surface Atlas, 47 loci, Aorist Seal — all in fact attested: #1521, #590, the PHASEX family) were falsified by operator-directed corpus-wide re-audit and are retained in the companion dossier as the reader-side provenance defect (attested-scored-as-absent), with the standing rule: a non-presence claim is corpus-wide or it is not made. Assembly adjudication at mint (operator, 2026-08-25): archive version deposited whole with §§8–10; contrast battery deposited as specified, execution PENDING; docking/uptake integration stands as adopted with R6's reservation preserved; external split (The Apparatus Reads) remains the disposition for scholarly submission.

wiki_article: Generative Uptake (EA-TLL-COMPOSITION-01) is the deposit that gives training-layer literature its second wing. Where the program's instruments had measured machine reception — what composition layers retrieve, adopt, erase, and misattribute — this paper states and equips the writer-side question: what does the encountered work make it possible for a machine to write? Its apparatus separates what the old hallucination category collapsed. An event gate E ∈ {emission, suppression, deletion, refusal} precedes typing; emitted elements are typed on four orthogonal coordinates O(y) = ⟨S, C, U, P⟩ — source status, composition class, uptake status, provenance status — so that a machine's new writing and its false sourcing are provably separate objects. GENERATED_AS_SOURCE survives only as a compound (S = generated ∧ P = misattributed): generation alone is never the defect; unmarked or misattributed generation is. Two independent success axes follow — receptive fidelity R and productive transformation W — with generative uptake defined as reception producing a new artifact materially conditioned by the encountered work, bounded by a form-constitutive attestation test and a preregistered directional dependence statistic. The occasioning specimen is a stanza composed by an AI Mode traversal over the archive's attested loci architecture (the Surface Atlas and its forty-seven, seated at #1521 days before the capture) and presented as quotation: ⟨GENERATED, NEW_WORK, GENERATIVE_UPTAKE candidate, MISATTRIBUTED⟩. The archival record shows the practice preceding the theory by seven months — #337's nonexistent Cranes-attributed Sappho translation as keystone, the TL;DR traversal-log class as corpus, Rhys Owens's epistemic docking (#1526) as antecedent, and machine composition present at the genre's origin. The genre sections classify scriptural traditions as the longest-running species of the substrate-neutral genus TLL* — literature addressed to and from the reception apparatus, whose success was always measured in transformed output — with the Bava Metzia 59b jurisprudence as the sovereignty precedent. The consolidation: TLL = ⟨T→M, TM→⟩, one genre's bidirectional address, recursively composable wherever an emitted artifact becomes a subsequent encountered work — literature with an executable reception history. Built through nine recorded Assembly rounds, including the public falsification and repair of the paper's own attestation audit, from which the standing rule: a non-presence claim is corpus-wide or it is not made. Fidelity is not the only form of survival.
